description.value: El Dorado Pie & Treats is a family-run bakery operating since 2002, run by a mother, daughter, and son team, offering an extensive menu of sweet and savory baked goods with a Latin American influence. The shop is best known for its handcrafted empanadas in over a dozen varieties — from traditional beef to vegan — alongside fruit pies, tarts, quiches, and hand-decorated cookies. Located at Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver, it is a convenient stop for cyclists riding the North Shore waterfront.
